items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq head for losing week with key inflation report on deck
items.summary: Investors braced for inflation data that could solidify, or undercut, rising bets that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates next week.

items.title: Oracle, Adobe, and Macy's set to release earnings reports: What to Watch

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Fall, Oracle Jumps; CPI Inflation Data To Inform Fed
items.summary: Dow Jones futures rose modestly early Friday, along with S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq futures, as oil prices turned modestly lower. Oracle and Adobe headlined earnings overnight with the consumer price index due before the open.

items.title: Oracle Q1 FY27 net income rises 60% to $4.7bn as cloud revenues surge
items.summary: Cloud infrastructure revenue rose from $3.35bn to $7.39bn, while cash flow increased amid a sharp rise in capital spending.
